restock.description: Engine 4 — /restock. NOT a quiz. One picker (which box do you own), then two tabs filtered by gates. Two taps to cart. No pre-checks, no stage question, max ONE reorder-suggestion row.

entry_picker.question: Which box do you have?
entry_picker.follow_up_ezclassic: footprint chips: 28x28 / 38x38 / 48x48 / 48x76 (TALL only) — needed ONLY to filter rail parts, rail kits, and matched consumable sizes
entry_picker.not_sure: link 'Not sure which box? Send us a photo' -> /support-request
entry_picker.future: email lookup via Shopify order history replaces the picker for known customers (planned, not this build)

restock.gate_model: Each item carries gates. system: ezclassic|fab|universal · height: standard|tall (EZC hard gate) · footprint: list (hard gate) · fab_panel: 3ft|4ft. Windowed is NEVER a gate on parts — windowed panels on a solid box are an upgrade; badge them 'Adds a window'.

rail_part_span_logic_official.corner_pieces: a 4-pack of rail corner pieces is necessary for ANY custom rail setup
